definitions.explanation: The act of decorating a space or object, or the decorations themselves. Used for holiday decorations, party setups, store displays, and general ornamentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I decorated the classroom together with the children.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a noun (the decorations or the act of decorating) and as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Very common around holidays and events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飾|かざ}り{付|つ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to decorate)
- ⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}け (Christmas decorations)
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}け (room decoration)
- {飾|かざ}り{付|つ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧ (to take down decorations)
